In detail

A quiet, mostly residential and rail-adjacent district. Local reporting described chronic urban decay around the station and piazza — littering, vandalised cars, tension around an informal encampment — with a resident warning about ongoing neglect. No evidence of violent crime or organised drug dealing, just documented decay concentrated near the station and piazza at night.
